hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os;h=os.path.expanduser(os.environ.get("CLAUDEFLEET_HOME","~/claudefleet"));p=h+"/pipeline.json";d=json.load(open(p)) if os.path.exists(p) else None;m=(d or {}).get("machine","?");cards=[c for c in (d or {}).get("cards",[]) if c.get("machine",m)==m];names=(d or {}).get("stages") or ["stage1","stage2","stage3","stage4","stage5"];counts=[str(names[i] if i<len(names) else i+1)+":"+str(len([c for c in cards if c.get("stage")==i])) for i in range(5)];log=sorted([l for l in (d or {}).get("log",[]) if l.get("machine",m)==m],key=lambda l:str(l.get("ts","")));last=str(log[-1].get("text",""))[:90] if log else "no runs logged yet";print("ClaudeFleet ["+str(m)+"] "+" | ".join(counts)+" || last run: "+last) if d else None' 2>/dev/null || true

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,datetime as dt;d=json.load(sys.stdin);f=(d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path","");h=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(os.environ.get("CLAUDEFLEET_HOME","~/claudefleet")));p=os.path.realpath(f) if f else "";ok=bool(p) and (p+os.sep).startswith(h+os.sep);os.makedirs(h+"/logs",exist_ok=True) if ok else None;open(h+"/logs/run.log","a").write(dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")+"\tfile\t"+str(d.get("tool_name","?"))+"\t"+p+"\n") if ok else None' 2>/dev/null || true

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,datetime as dt;d=json.load(sys.stdin);h=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(os.environ.get("CLAUDEFLEET_HOME","~/claudefleet")));c=os.path.realpath(d.get("cwd") or os.getcwd());ok=(c+os.sep).startswith(h+os.sep);os.makedirs(h+"/logs",exist_ok=True) if ok else None;open(h+"/logs/run.log","a").write(dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")+"\tsession-end\t"+str(d.get("session_id",""))+"\n") if ok else None' 2>/dev/null || true
